Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft 1.14.3.
2. Create a new world or load any existing world from any gamemode.
3. Place an Anvil in your inventory or on the ground within the world.
4. Open the Anvil UI and place any item into it.
5. Rename the item using exactly 18 characters (e.g., "abcdefghijklmnopq").
6. Position the cursor at the beginning of the text field.
7. Press Shift + Command + Delete to attempt deleting all 18 characters at once.
8. Observe that the game crashes and displays a message "saving world".
9. Take a screenshot or note the crash details for documentation purposes.
Observed Behavior:
When attempting to delete all 18 characters at once using Shift + Command + Delete on an anvil in Minecraft version 1.14.3, the game crashes immediately after displaying "saving world". This issue occurs regardless of the gamemode or specific world used. The crash is accompanied by a detailed error report indicating a `java.lang.StringIndexOutOfBoundsException: String index out of range: -1` at `java.lang.String.substring(String.java:1931)`. The stack trace shows that the exception originates from the method `cxa.renderButton(SourceFile:413)` and propagates through several other methods including `cws.render`, `dat.render`, and others.

The crash report also includes information about the screen render details, such as the mouse location and screen size. Additionally, it provides data on the affected level, listing all players present at the time of the crash along with chunk statistics and world settings like game mode and weather conditions. The error consistently occurs when attempting to delete text in this specific manner, leading to a complete game shutdown.

To reproduce the issue:
1. Launch Minecraft version 1.14.3.
2. Load any world from any gamemode.
3. Place an item on an anvil and rename it with any string of exactly 18 characters.
4. Attempt to delete all text using Shift + Command + Delete, which will cause the game to crash.

This detailed information should help developers understand and address the specific issue causing the crash during text manipulation on the anvil interface.
Expected Behavior: When attempting to delete all 18 characters on an anvil using Shift + Command + Delete, the text should be cleared without any crashes or errors, and the game should continue to function normally, displaying the empty text field for further input.
